name: Space Dash
description: A fast arcade space shooter: dodge asteroids, blast rocks, chain multipliers.
longDescription: Space Dash is the reference content pack for the AgentOS web engine. Steer your ship through a procedurally spawning asteroid belt, shoot rocks to score, and chain kills quickly to build a multiplier up to x8. Your high score is saved through the AgentOS bridge and survives game updates. The entire game is a single self-contained HTML file — no remote resources, fully offline after install.
author: AgentOS
